risks: React 19 is paired with React 18 type packages, which can cause false type errors. Next.js and its lint config are pinned to an exact version, while others use ranges.
debug: Install failures usually point to a version conflict. Type errors near React components may come from the type package mismatch. Run the typecheck command to see errors.
